## 1. Executive Overview | Goal | What we want to achieve | |------|------------------------| | **Authentic, resonant storytelling** | Every faith‑based or cultural pillar feels *real* to the local audience, not a marketing “copy‑paste” | | **Fast, friction‑free approval** | A single, transparent path from creative ideation → regional sign‑off → global launch | | **Real‑time, cross‑border risk mitigation** | Detect, de‑escalate, or amplify signals before backlash turns into PR crises | | **Consistent brand voice, local depth** | Global brand integrity + local nuance, amplified by trusted local partners | | **Measurable impact & learning loop** | Quantify lift, sentiment, and lessons to feed the next campaign | > **Bottom‑line** – The framework turns the *culture‑risk* of faith‑based, seasonal marketing into a predictable, low‑variance asset that can scale across Gulf, North Africa, Southeast Asia, South Asia, India, and Western markets. --- ## 2. Core Principles | Principle | Why it matters | Practical sign‑off | |-----------|----------------|---------------------| | **People‑First Storytelling** | Brand relevance stems from people, not commodities | Campaign brief requires *at least one* real‑world story/quote from a local community member | | **Respectful Representation** | Avoid stereotypes; use correct religion, language, and iconography | Cultural vetting checklist (e.g., “Does the image respect the sanctity of Ramadan?”) | | **Inclusive Voice** | Different groups identify with the brand at different levels | Each campaign includes a “community voice” clause in the creative brief | | **Audit‑Ready Transparency** | Every creative decision can be explained in two sentences | All assets tagged with “Cultural Vet Officer” stamp & short narrative | | **Speed‑with‑Care** | Agility is required in fast‑moving social media | Dual approval (local + global) is achieved through a “Single‑Click Launch” system built on a cloud CMS | --- ## 3. Stakeholder Map & Governance | Role | Primary Responsibility | Key Touch‑points | |------|------------------------|------------------| | **Brand House (HQ)** | Set overall brand tone, legal & ESG compliance | Weekly “Pulse” calls, final launch sign‑off | | **Global Campaign Lead (GL)** | Own cross‑regional strategy, budget, KPI alignment | Daily brief sync with regional leads | | **Regional Creative Lead (RCL)** | Own narrative, visuals, voice for the region | Weekly creative review, cultural vetting | | **Agency “Cultural Concierge” (ACC)** | Execute creative, perform localization & translation | Daily stand‑up, ad‑hoc brief changes | | **Local Community Liaison (LCL)** | Voice community perspective, pre‑test messages | Monthly community check‑in | | **Compliance + Legal (CL)** | Ensure ad content meets local regulations & export‑control | Pre‑launch audit, sign‑off | | **PR Crisis Manager (PCM)** | Rapid response in case of backlash | 24‑hour escalation matrix | | **Social Media & Data Analyst (SDA)** | Real‑time sentiment & engagement monitoring | Daily dashboards & ad‑hoc alerts | > **Governance Pillar** – **The “Authenticity Committee”** (one member from each role). The committee meets twice a month on a shared virtual white‑board and has a simple “Yes/No/Revise” vote on every creative concept. --- ## 4. Framework Phases > **Phase 0 – Ideation & Cultural Research (Weeks –2→–1)** > **Phase 1 – Co‑Creation & Localization (Weeks 0‑2)** > **Phase 2 – Unified Approval & Risk Mitigation (Weeks 2‑3)** > **Phase 3 – Launch & Amplification (Week 3‑4)** > **Phase 4 – Post‑Launch Analysis & Knowledge Capture (Week 4‑6)** Below is the detailed, step‑by‑step playbook for each phase. --- ### 4.1 Phase 0 – Ideation & Cultural Research | Task | Owner | Deliverable | |------|-------|-------------| | **Macro‑calendar sync** | GL | Calendar of “Key Dates” (Ramadan, Lunar New Year, Diwali, etc.) | | **Community Insight Pack** | LCL | 30‑minute “Day‑in‑the‑Life” video or 3‑slide narrative per cultural pillar | | **Cultural Risk Matrix** | ACC + CL | Matrix of potential pitfalls (e.g., taboo food items in Ramadan) | | **Audience Persona Refresh** | SDA | Updated personas including cultural, linguistic, and media consumption nuances | | **Pre‑brief Checklist** | RCL | 12‑point “Do we respect the sacred, do we have a community voice?” list | > **Approval Signal** – Pre‑brief sign‑off by GL + CL (no more than 24 hrs after Idea approval). --- ### 4.2 Phase 1 – Co‑Creation & Localization | Day | Actions | Tools & Templates | |-----|---------|-------------------| | **Day 1–2** | **Creative Brief Workshop** – RCL + ACC + LCL | “Culturally Authentic Brief” template (Goal, Narrative Arc, Key Message, Tone, Do/Don’ts) | | **Day 3–4** | **Concept Development** – 3 storyboards per language | Visual‑Storyboard Pad, 1‑minute “Pitch” videos | | **Day 5** | **Community Review** – 2‑hour video call with 3 community representatives (via LCL) | Zoom + sentiment annotation | | **Day 6–7** | **Text & Visual Localisation** – ACC handles translation & imagery tweaks | Cloud‑based CMS (e.g., Bynder) with “Lingo + Meaning” fields | | **Day 8** | **Cultural Vetting Pass** – ACC + LCL signs “Cultural Vet & Sign‑off” badge | Digital stamp in asset metadata | | **Day 9** | **Compliance Pre‑Screen** | CL verifies ad copy, imagery vs. country ad‑law (e.g., US FCC, UAE FTC) | | **Day 10** | **Global Preview** | GL reviews the final set (including “Community Voice Section” & “Compliance Certificate”) | > **Deliverable** – One final, multi‑language “Story Package” ready for approval. --- ### 4.3 Phase 2 – Unified Approval & Risk Mitigation | Approval Layer | Owner | Time Box | Key Questions | |----------------|-------|----------|---------------| | **Stage A – Local Sign‑off** | RCL (Local Ops) | 12 hrs post‑final preview | • Does the story reflect local values?
• Are we compliant with local advertising law? | | **Stage B – Brand House Gate** | GL + CL | 24 hrs | • Does it align with global brand tone?
• Is there commercial risk? | | **Stage C – Crisis Pre‑scan** | PCM + SDA | 12 hrs | • Potential negative sentiment triggers?
• Does any phrase cross a “red‑flag” in our sentiment lexicon? | | **Stage D – Final Launch OK** | All | 12 hrs | • Are we ready for “Single‑Click Launch”? | - **Decision Flow** – If any layer returns “Revise”, the asset goes back to the *Development Loop* (not a full rewrite). - **Audit Trail** – Every signature is timestamped and logged in the CMS; the final “Launch Bundle” includes a PDF of the sign‑off sheet. --- ### 4.4 Phase 3 – Launch & Amplification | Day | Tactics | Channels | Risk Mitigation | |-----|---------|----------|-----------------| | **Day 0** | **Soft‑launch** – 1 hour A/B test on a single region (priority market) | Paid social + 1 email blast | Pre‑programmed “slow‑burn” budget; monitoring on day‑1 sentiment | | **Day 1** | **Global Sync‑Op** – Broadcast on central platforms (LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok) | Cross‑platform | Real‑time dashboard (SDA) set to flash alerts on > 10 % drop in satisfaction | | **Day 2‑4** | **Community Engagement** – Influencer & local community posts | YouTube Shorts, Regional IG Reels | Community managers ready to respond within 5 min | | **Day 5‑7** | **Data‑Driven Tweaks** – Adjust ad copy if negative trend appears | Paid social | “Pause‑And‑Re‑analyse” protocol: automatically pause 25 % of spend if signal occurs | | **Day 8‑21** | **Sustained Amplification** – Top‑perform creatives repurposed, cross‑promoted | Email newsletters, Retail signage | Continuous monitoring, escalation to PCM if negative sentiment > 2 % | > **Key KPI** – *Share of Conversation (SOC)* in each region should not be negative; any spike in negative SOC triggers an “Escalation Playbook” (see Section 6). --- ### 4.5 Phase 4 – Post‑Launch Analysis & Knowledge Capture | Activity | Owner | Deliverable | |----------|-------|-------------| | **Campaign Review Meeting** | GL + PCM + RCL | “Campaign Impact” deck: lift, sentiment, ROI, lessons | | **Cultural Audit Report** | ACC + LCL | 12‑page report: did we hit authenticity? Which community sentiment signals were most telling? | | **Global Knowledge Hub Update** | SDA | Curated asset library + “Do/Don’ts” index | | **Process Improvement Backlog** | Auth. Committee | Prioritized items for next campaign (e.g., new data source, updated compliance checklist) | > **Timeframe** – Review completed within 6 days of campaign end, data archive stored for 12 months. --- ## 5. Authenticity Toolkit (“Cultural Vetting Checklist”) | Category | Question | Yes/No | Comment | |----------|----------|--------|---------| | **Narrative** | Does the story feature a *real* local figure or community event? | | | | **Visuals** | Is the imagery respectful of local customs (e.g., modest clothing for Ramadan)? | | | | **Language** | Are all languages properly translated & culturally appropriate? | | | | **Music & Sound** | Does the soundtrack reflect local traditions (e.g., instrumental hijaz for Gulf)? | | | | **Product Placement** | Is the product positioned in a relatable, everyday context? | | | | **Call‑to‑Action** | Does the CTA align with local consumer behaviour (e.g., “Order now” vs. “Buy family pack”)? | | | > A **digital stamp** is generated if every “Yes” answers – “Fully Localised & Approved”. --- ## 6. Crisis & Backlash Escalation Matrix | Severity | Typical Signals | Owner | Initial Response | Escalation Path | |----------|----------------|-------|------------------|------------------| | **Low** (1–2 % negative sentiment) | Minor typo, small cultural mis‑step | PCM + SDA | Minor correction + brief apology | No escalation | | **Medium** (3–5 % negative sentiment) | Perceived faux‑pas, small groups protesting | PCM + RCL | Public clarification + quick community engagement | PCM → GL → Legal (if needed) | | **High** (> 5 % negative sentiment) | Widespread backlash, local media coverage | PCM + Legal → CL | Immediate PR statement, pull unsatisfactory ad components | CL → GDPR / regulatory agencies, potentially suspension of campaign | > **Decision Tool** – A simple 3‑point ladder (Low‑Mid‑High) automatically flags the appropriate SOP in the campaign hub. --- ## 7. Risk & Compliance Gating | Risk Category | Specific Concern | Mitigation | |----------------|------------------|------------| | **Export control** | Mis‑use of tech logos or slogans in restricted markets | Export‑control screening tool before any asset leaves HQ | | **Advertising law** | Misrepresentation of product claims in India (FSSAI) | CL pre‑screen + “Compliance File” | | **Data privacy** | Collection of religious data (e.g., Ramadan shopping patterns) | GDPR / APP compliant cookie banner; data minimisation | | **Cultural offense** | Use of sacred symbols (e.g., Quran excerpts) | Cultural Vet Officer sign‑off; local review | | **Health & Safety** | Food safety claims over cross‑border shipping | Quality audit certificate attached to campaign assets | A **“Compliance Passport”** (PDF) travels with each creative asset through every approval stage to maintain audit readiness. --- ## 8. Measurement & KPI Dashboard | KPI | Definition | Target | Data Source | Owner | |-----|------------|--------|-------------|-------| | **Authenticity Score** | % of “Yes” on Cultural Vetting Checklist | ≥ 95 % | Checklist audit | RCL | | **First‑Day Reach** | Unique users hitting the ad | ≥ X % of target | Ad platform analytics | SDA | | **Sentiment Index** | Net positive‐negative sentiment | ≥ +0.5 | Social listening tools | SDA | | **Engagement Rate** | Likes + comments + shares / reach | ≥ 3 % | Social media | SDA | | **Brand Lift** | Survey of awareness & favorability | ≥ +5 % | Post‑campaign survey | GL | | **Compliance Penalty Incidence** | Number of regulatory complaints | = 0 | Legal & Compliance logs | CL | | **Crisis Response Time** | Avg. time between signal & public response | ≤ 2 h | PCM dashboard | PCM | > **Reporting cadence** – Daily for social metrics; weekly for brand lift and compliance; quarterly for strategic adjustments. --- ## 9. Resource Allocation Snapshot (per campaign) | Role | Full‑Time Equivalent (FTE) | Hours/Week | Notes | |------|---------------------------|------------|-------| | **Brand House Lead** | 0.2 | 8 | Decision‑maker | | **Cultural Concierge** | 0.6 | 26 | Handles 3 regions | | **Local Community Liaison** | 0.4 | 16 | 1 per region | | **Compliance Officer** | 0.1 | 4 | Legal vetting | | **Social Media Analyst** | 0.3 | 12 | Sentiment monitoring | | **PR Crisis Manager** | 0.2 | 8 | 24/7 standby | | **Creative Designers (regional)** | 0.8 | 32 | 2 per region | | **Copywriters (regional)** | 0.6 | 24 | 1 per region | --- ## 10. “One‑Stop” Campaign Hub – The Digital Workspace **Platform** – A single, cloud‑based CMS (e.g., Bynder + Zapier) orchestrates all workflows: 1. **Asset Repository** – Original, localized, and final assets in one folder tree. 2. **Approval Board** – Each stage visualized; digital stamps auto‑generate audit logs. 3. **Live Dashboards** – KPI metrics, sentiment alerts, cost tracking. 4. **Smart Rules Engine** – “If sentiment < 0.6, pause 25 % of spend automatically”. 5. **Knowledge Vault** – Historical briefs, cultural briefs, compliance forms. > **Security** – Role‑based access, two‑factor authentication, encryption in transit & at rest. --- ## 11. Sample “Ramadan Campaign Playbook” | Week | Activity | Owner | Key Touchpoints | |------|----------|-------|-----------------| | **-2** | Cultural research & community video | LCL | Community leaders | | **-1** | Creative brief workshop | RCL + ACC | Brand House | | **0** | Storyboard & translation | ACC | LCL | | **0.5** | Community review & feedback | LCL + RCL | Community groups | | **1** | Compliance scan | CL | Legal counsel | | **1.5** | Global preview | GL | RCL | | **2** | Local sign‑off | RCL | ACC | | **2.5** | Crisis pre‑scan | PCM | SDA | | **3** | Soft‑launch in Gulf | Paid Social | Local micro‑influencer | | **4** | Data‑driven tweak | SDA | Ad‑ops | | **5** | Global amplification | GL | All channels | | **7** | Review & learn | Auth. Committee | Full squad | | **8** | Knowledge capture | SDA | Auth. Committee | > **Post‑campaign** – Conduct a 1‑minute “impact story” featuring a Gulf community leader, to be reused in next cycle. --- ## 12. Final Take‑away Checklist 1. **Start with a Shared Vision** – All stakeholders sign a *“Campaign Authenticity Charter”* before any creative work. 2. **Use the 4‑Layer Approval Flow** – Local → Brand → Legal → Crisis → Launch. 3. **Build the “Authenticity Badge”** into every asset metadata. 4. **Monitor 4‑hour windows** – every negative sentiment spark triggers a crisis SOP. 5. **Document everything** – from community videos to compliance certificates. 6. **Re‑invite the community** after launch – their voices become next‑cycle catalysts. By embedding culture, compliance, and rapid‑response governance into a single, repeatable blueprint, the global food brand can celebrate faith‑based and cultural seasonal moments that not only resonate powerfully but also safeguard against backlash—no matter how fast the social‑media wheel turns.
